item.title: A series of tricks and techniques I learned doing tiny GLSL demos
item.description:
📝 Let's simplify the problem with the following figure: A ray passing by a radiating object The glowing object sends photons that spread all around it. The further we go from the object, the more spread these photons are, basically following the inverse square law 1/r^2, which gives the photons density, where r is the distance to the target object. Given two arbitrary sampling points and their corresponding distance d_n and d_{n+1}, any intermediate distance can be linearly interpolated with r=\mathrm{mix}(d_n,d_{n+1},t) where t is within [0,1].
🔗 Read more: https://blog.pkh.me/p/48-a-series-of-tricks-and-techniques-i-learned-doing-tiny-glsl-demos.html

item.title: RIP Tetsu Yamauchi (Former Free and Faces Bassist)
item.description:
📝 Tetsu Yamauchi onstage with the Faces in 1973 (Image credit: Ian Dickson/Redferns) Tetsu Yamauchi, former bassist with Free and the Faces, has died at the age of 79. In 1985, he formed the Ope Band with free jazz drummer Shoji Hano, a relationship that also produced Dare Devil, a 1992 live album recorded with renowned free jazz saxophonist and clarinettist Peter Brötzmann and guitarist Haruhiko Gotsu. “Just heard that Tetsu passed away," Simon Kirke wrote on social media.
🔗 Read more: https://www.loudersound.com/bands-artists/former-free-and-faces-bassist-tetsu-yamauchi-dead-at-79

item.title: How the Creator Economy Destroyed the Internet
item.description:
📝 Verge homepageSearchTechReviewsScienceEntertainmentAIHow the creator economy destroyed the internetA special series from The VergeIt’sIt’s fashionable to talk about the creator economy like it’s a new thing, but the harsh reality is that the creator economy is the media and internet economy now. There are not many industries where it’s more valuable to stop selling bits and start selling atoms, but every major creator eventually pivots to selling products because it’s more lucrative than chasing views and brand deals. The platforms need influencers and influencers need audiences — but what the influenced need is not so simple.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theverge.com/cs/features/810002/influencers-creator-economy-special-series
